caption: The drawing features two rectangular swatches of woven fabric on a light, off-white background. The fabric swatches display a blue and white plaid pattern, with the smaller swatch positioned above the larger one. Both pieces of fabric have visible textures from their woven fibers, with the larger swatch exhibiting frayed edges. Surrounding the fabric samples are four irregularly shaped, beige stains, one near each corner of the drawing, with the top and bottom stains being particularly elongated. The lower right area of the drawing has a small blue handwritten signature.
